name: harness-lens
description: 3-Layer harness control plane (hooks + MCP + live web UI) for Codex CLI. Gates and records every tool call against Layer 1 invariants / Layer 2 domain criteria / Layer 3 QA thresholds; a SessionStart hook auto-starts a local daemon that holds the ledger and serves the UI at http://127.0.0.1:7700/ui.
